summary: Chunghwa Telecom filed a Form 6-K furnishing three Taiwan-market announcements dated 2026/11/06: Board approval of consolidated financial statements for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 (revenue NT$188.9bn, net income NT$34.8bn, EPS NT$4.25); Board authorization of unsecured corporate bonds up to NT$20bn in total, issued at 100% of par with fixed coupon, maturities generally up to 10 years, no collateral or guarantor, proceeds for capex, debt repayment and working capital; and a new Chief Audit Executive appointment. None constitutes a special situation; the debt shelf is routine financing and the audit executive role is not a CEO/CFO/board departure.
